pr_lead_time_hours.definition: First commit on the PR branch → merge commit.

issue_to_merge_hours.definition: First commit referencing the issue → merge commit. A LOWER BOUND: the issue creation time is not in git history.

review_rounds.definition: Distinct commit subjects on the PR branch. A proxy for review rounds from git-only data.

pr_size_lines.definition: Added + removed lines in the merge commit.

revert_hotfix_rate.definition: Revert commits per merged PR, over the window.

ci_failure_rate.definition: Commits whose subject repeats within the window, over all commits. A proxy for CI failures — CI results are not in git history.

dora.reason: DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore) come from CI/CD and incident history, not from git. The owner must supply them.
